title: GitHub and the board
tagline: What lives in GitHub, what lives on the board, and how work moves between them.
outcomes: Decide where a piece of work belongs
Work a GitHub issue in a room
Move a task to GitHub when it turns out to matter

quiz.question: A flaky test needs fixing this afternoon. Where does it go?
options: A GitHub issue, so it's tracked
A task on the board: it's work happening now, done in an hour
quiz.why: GitHub is for what has to outlast the work. A ten-minute fix is work happening now, so it's a task on the board.
